findings.correction: Going by the Head Elder’s expression, he looked like a muscular old man at a gym asking whether you’d eaten. But the content of his words was vicious beyond belief.
findings.current: Going by his expression, he looked like a muscular old man at a gym asking whether you’d eaten. But the content of his words was vicious beyond belief.
findings.defect: After the White Tiger Hall Leader’s line, “his” attaches to the wrong speaker. The gym-grandpa face and vicious speech are the Head Elder’s.
findings.rationale: 백호당주 only says “노, 노야.” The 몸짱 할아버지 simile and 살벌한 내용 describe the Head Elder. Misassigned identity is a scene-fact error.
findings.source: 표정만 보면 밥 먹었냐 물어보는 헬스장 몸짱 할아버진데, 말하는 내용은 살벌하기 그지없다.

findings.correction: He wasn’t normally like this, which made him even scarier now that he was angry.
findings.current: He was frightening when angry. Much more frightening than usual.
findings.defect: Turns a man who is not usually like this into someone who is already frightening “as usual.”
findings.rationale: 안 그러던 사람 marks Wikyung’s anger as uncharacteristic, not an intensification of a usual aura.
findings.source: 안 그러던 사람이 화가 나니 더 무섭다.

findings.defect: Softens 좆 됐네 to vague disapproval.
findings.rationale: Rules require matching profanity strength. 좆 됐네 is “we’re/I’m fucked,” not “this is bad.”

findings.correction: Preparing for the worst, I started edging toward the door
findings.current: I slowly turned toward the door, preparing for the worst
findings.defect: 슬금슬금 is stealthy edging, not merely slow turning; the comic sneak-out beat is lost.
findings.rationale: The narrator is already sneaking for the exit when the Head Elder speaks. Slowly ≠ furtively.
findings.source: 최악의 상황을 대비해 슬금슬금 문 쪽으로 몸을 돌리는

findings.correction: That bastard was bald, and he couldn’t read the room either.
findings.current: That bastard was bald, and he didn’t have a shred of sense, either.
findings.defect: 눈치 is failure to read the room, the punchline after he blurts 냉큼 into Wikyung’s frost. “Sense” is generic.
findings.rationale: The joke pairs no hair with no 눈치, set up by speaking 냉큼 in a chilling atmosphere.
findings.source: 저 새끼는 모발도 없는데 눈치까지 없네.

findings.correction: Those men not only framed a direct-line member of the family, but even argued we should hand him over to the enemy.
findings.current: Those men not only slandered a direct-line member of the family, but also claimed that we should hand him over to our enemies.
findings.defect: 모함 is framing/false implication, not mere slander.
findings.rationale: The council charge is a poisoning frame-up. Slander weakens the accusation the Head Elder is pressing.
findings.source: 저들은 가문의 직계를 모함하는 것으로도 모자라 적들에게 넘기자고 주장했는데

findings.correction: Still, with masters like Jin Wikyung and Wipeng, it was a fight worth attempting.
findings.current: Still, if we had masters like Jin Wikyung and Wipeng, it was a battle we might be able to win.
findings.defect: 해 볼 만한 싸움 is a fight worth attempting, not a fight they might win.
findings.rationale: The next Peak-count (3 vs 5) undercuts any “might win.” The source only says the fight is worth trying.
findings.source: 그래도 진위경과 위팽 같은 고수들이 있다면 해 볼 만한 싸움이다.

findings.correction: The moment I saw the corners of Jin Wikyung’s mouth quiver and the Head Elder’s strange smile
findings.current: The moment I saw Jin Wikyung’s trembling smile and the Head Elder’s strange grin
findings.defect: Adds a smile. Source is Wikyung’s quivering mouth-corners plus the Head Elder’s odd smile.
findings.rationale: Wikyung has stayed stiff-faced. 입꼬리 떨림 is not 웃음; making him smile changes the election-stump tableau.
findings.source: 파르르 떨리는 진위경의 입꼬리와 대장로의 묘한 웃음을 보는 순간

findings.correction: Was that talk or a fart?
findings.current: What was that supposed to be, a proposition or a fart?
findings.defect: 말 is speech/talk, not a proposition.
findings.rationale: The insult is 말 vs 방구. “Proposition” upgrades the register and changes the joke.

findings.current: The Head Elder threw back his head and laughed.
findings.defect: Adds a head-throw the source does not have. 껄껄 is a hearty laugh only.
findings.rationale: Fidelity forbids inventing physical actions to punch up a laugh.

findings.correction: Fuck, I can’t figure him out at all.
findings.current: Fuck, I can’t read him at all.
findings.defect: 도저히 모르겠다 is “I can’t figure him out.” “Can’t read him” duplicates and pre-empts the later 표정을 못 읽겠어.
findings.rationale: The chapter then lists other NPCs’ readable faces and only after that concludes he can’t read the Head Elder’s expression.

findings.correction: we are already too late to reverse it.
findings.current: we are too late to put it back in its sheath.
findings.defect: 되돌리다 is reverse/undo. The sheath is an added mechanism.
findings.rationale: The sword-hilt metaphor is in 칼자루/뽑혔는지. Sheathing is not in the source.

summary: Several character and register errors: Head Elder’s gym-grandpa aside can attach to the White Tiger Hall Leader; Wikyung’s unusual anger, Taekyung’s sneaking, 모함, and 좆 됐네 are weakened; Wikyung is given a smile the source does not state.
